title: data/editions.json
description: Registry of instruments and their editions, per jurisdiction: the layer GATE-2 asked for. The skeleton names the edition it consolidates; every corpus names the edition its text reflects; two editions of one jurisdiction may be registered at once. See docs/adr/0013-corpus-files-with-editions.md.

instrument.$comment: The body of rules this jurisdiction's editions are editions of.

skeleton.$comment: Which edition data/rules.json consolidates for this jurisdiction; null while the skeleton has no paragraphs of it.

amended_through.$comment: Free text: national amalgamations cite their own amending acts, not IMO resolutions.

superseded_by.$comment: The later edition, where two are registered and one has lapsed.
